title: Tile kernel manifest v1
description: Per-(kernel, target) record the compiler emits beside a device artifact (spec xpu-tile-manifest). Fields the target cannot report are ABSENT, never zero.

target.description: Backend and arch, e.g. amdgpu/gfx1151, nvptx/sm_89, spirv/vulkan1.3, cpu/x86-64-v3

footprint.description: From the assembled artifact (spec §3). Absent when the target does not report it.

ldsDynamicParam.description: Name of the launch parameter that sizes dynamic shared memory

threadsPerGroup.description: Present only when pinned by @Tile or @Occupancy

feasibleBlocks.description: Best-first, from the occupancy picker, when the block is a launch argument

residentGroupsPerCu.description: Resident groups per driver multiprocessor (the occupancy picker's unit: a WGP on RDNA, an SM on NVIDIA) at the pinned block. Capacity accounting unit only — never a performance target

work.description: The work model derived from the kernel body (spec §4). Costs are per group for a kernel on the Group surface, per work item for a hand kernel, and each is an expression over the kernel's parameters or measured.

costUnit.description: What one cost counts: a Group summed over its lanes, or one work item (spec §4.5a)

workAxisParam.description: The parameter that is the roofline coordinate (token count, row count, item count)

intOps.description: Integer multiplies and multiply-adds whose result is not only an index; a vector dot counts its lanes

buffers.description: One entry per KernelBuffer parameter, in declaration order.

storedBits.description: The payload width: @Stored(bits = N) when stated (4 for MXFP4 weights), else the element width

perItemCost.description: For ragged launches: cost of one item, e.g. alpha*l_q + beta*l_kv

granularity.description: Per-axis multiple a launch dimension must round to

pinned.description: true when @Tile pinned the shape for this target; false when defaulted

splitAxis.description: Name of the reduction axis the kernel exposes for split-K / KV-chunk parallelism, if any

nativeOps.description: The instruction each cooperative-matrix verb lowered to on this target (xpu-kernel-adaptor 4A.2.6). Always present, and empty when the kernel has no cooperative-matrix verbs.

instruction.description: A native intrinsic (nvvm.wmma..., amdgcn.wmma..., spirv.OpCooperativeMatrixMulAddKHR) or the portable tile: software-tile.replicated or software-tile.distributed

restartable.description: Derived: read and write sets disjoint, no accumulate or readwrite buffer (spec §6.5)

drainsDevice.description: A global reduction the host or a scalar decision consumes; scheduled as a barrier node (spec §6.7)

yieldEveryGroups.description: Spacing of yield checks in groups, chosen for 10–50 µs of work between checks (spec §8.2a)

numericTier.description: Declared tolerance vs the family's exact member, e.g. 'rel<=0.5%, 0 rows >2%'

schedule.description: Author intent echoed (spec §11). Hints, never ground truth.

costExpr.description: Arithmetic over parameter names, tile constants and integer literals with + - * / and parentheses, e.g. '4*cols' or '17*blocksPerRow', or the word measured: the runtime fills it from observation. There is no author-declared cost (spec D6).
